events.title: Biological Incident
events.description: A real biological incident with model involvement: a deliberate release or a laboratory escape involving a designed or modified agent. Casualties are real, containment runs for weeks, and every argument about AI risk in every jurisdiction is reset by it.

events.title: Frontier Access Denied
events.description: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user. No detailed reason is given, there is no appeal, and the immediate practical effect lands on hospitals, ministries and firms that had built on it. Whether this reads at home as an outrage or as a failure of foresight depends on what the Union had done about it beforehand.

events.title: Coercion Over ASML
events.description: Washington forces the Netherlands to cut ASML's exports and servicing further still – beyond the leading-edge machines to the older lithography equipment China uses for ordinary chips, and in the harder versions to a widening list of other customers. The instrument is jurisdiction over American technology in the supply chain, and refusing it is not obviously survivable for the company. The Union's one chokepoint is being used, and not by the Union.

events.title: emergent_disinfo_election_wave
events.description: A coordinated disinformation campaign using AI-generated content in multiple EU languages causes widespread confusion during regional elections in three member states, prompting emergency meetings of the European Electoral Board. The content is not decisive but erodes trust in digital campaigning and leads to calls for urgent regulation of political AI use.

portfolio.name: Tech sovereignty package
portfolio.description: Targets €200bn of private capital for AI data centres by 2036 and proposes accelerated-permitting zones

portfolio.name: Establish the European AI Assurance Directorate (EAAD)
portfolio.description: A new public agency to conduct independent pre-deployment evaluations of frontier models and audit safety claims with legal authority to delay releases

portfolio.name: Critical Infrastructure Resilience Surge (CIRS)
portfolio.description: A rapid, targeted hardening of energy, water, and transport control systems against AI-powered intrusion, with mandatory detection upgrades and cross-border red-teaming exercises
